COST_IMPACT.status: NOT YET COMPUTED — and deliberately not estimated.
COST_IMPACT.why: Durations for the Bonuses lessons were captured in some folders (Rapid Launch Stack: 15 videos summing to 178:29 = 2h58m) but NOT in the four course folders, whose tiles view rendered resolution+codecs+size instead. See the view-dependency finding below. Adding these to the 592.74 h forecast requires measured durations, not an extrapolation from file size.
COST_IMPACT.direction: The 592.74 h / USD 152.93 figure covers the 198 CALLS ONLY. It does not cover 15 Rapid Launch Stack videos (~2h58m measured) or 32 lesson videos in the four course folders (unmeasured). The forecast is therefore a LOWER BOUND.

VIEW_DEPENDENCY_FINDING.finding: Neither MEGA view carries both size and duration. TILES view sets a `title` attribute containing resolution + codecs + SIZE + name, and renders DURATION visibly. LIST view renders DURATION and leaves `title` EMPTY.
VIEW_DEPENDENCY_FINDING.consequence: A single sweep of any folder yields size OR duration depending on which view MEGA chose for it. Getting both requires forcing the view per folder. The full-share sweep is therefore a LOWER BOUND on measured bytes and a LOWER BOUND on measured hours, in different folders.
VIEW_DEPENDENCY_FINDING.this_is_not_a_defect_in_this_probe: It is a property of the container that had to be discovered. Two earlier size probes returned null because they read the rendered column, not the attribute — and a third returned null because it read the attribute in a folder MEGA had rendered as a list.

CORRECTED_CORPUS_SHAPE.statement: This share is not one thing. It is a mentorship call archive PLUS a five-course curriculum. They are different data with different shapes, different registers, and different costs. A single '198 calls' mental model does not describe it.
